content.short: GlueHook is a free, open-source Uniswap v4 hook automating buybacks, burns and self-compounding liquidity.
content.description: GlueHook is an open-source Uniswap v4 hook that automates token buybacks, burns and self-compounding of liquidity positions, so a project's pool can manage part of its own tokenomics without a team running scripts. It is deployed on Unichain and World Chain. Hooks like this turn a liquidity pool from a passive venue into something that executes policy.
content.meta: GlueHook is an open-source Uniswap v4 hook automating buybacks, burns and LP compounding on Unichain and World Chain.
